newsitem.title: USA: D&P rates NIPSCO unit's unsecured debt.
newsitem.headline: D&P rates NIPSCO unit's unsecured debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it assigned a credit rating of Single A Minus to NIPSCO Capital Markets' $300 million unsecured debt securities shelf registration.
NIPSCO Capital Markets is a subsidiary of NIPSCO Industries Inc that provides financing for affiliated nonutility ventures.
Concurrently, Duff & Phelps said it downgraded NIPSCO Capital Markets' quarterly income debt securities (QUIDS) to Triple B Plus from Single A Minus.
Duff & Phelps said the QUIDS downgrade does not reflect the recent financial performance of either NIPSCO Industries or its primary subsidiary, Northern Indiana P.S.

It reflects only structural subordination between NIPSCO and Northern Indiana P.S., the proportional changes in NIPSCO Capital Markets' capital structure, the increased leverage associated with both the anticipated issuance of the new unsecured notes and the approximately $116 million debt of IWC Resources Corp that is expected to be assumed in connection with its pending acquisition by NIPSCO.
